visual_review: Inspected the full five-stock positive/direct comparison pixels. Names, 25/25A, arrows, HP5 visible bar trace, holes and aperture layout remain visibly consistent. Direct polarity is appropriate for a negative light-table illustration.
model_review: Matches v12 D65 spectral endpoint method and continuous linear-display-light coverage projection. Four B&W own profiles retain exact neutral endpoint equivalence after native lane normalization. CineStill resolves the existing 500T alias without modifying scientific data.
limitations: D65 endpoint illustrations, not measurements of film-base appearance or factory edge exposure. Independent per-channel maximum values are a contrast bound, not necessarily one common exposure.
CineStill uses inherited Vision3 500T spectra; no separate measured CineStill base or marking spectrum is claimed.

Approved A is used for alpha, while direct RGB is reconstructed from v2 coverage. A subtle material texture is not carried into the direct candidate; this is intentional clean coverage, not exact A RGB retention.
Soft coverage is a raster linear-RGB projection, not the original latent-image mask. Mark coordinates and geometric alpha are exact; anti-aliased tonal values are intentionally remapped.
HP5 bars remain an authored visible trace, not a decoded/validated machine-readable DX code.
Pillow PNG/WebP equality and static model checks passed. No Android codec, compositor, APK, or runtime route test was performed. No compilation or source/integration edits.
